## Load packages

`pacman` loads the required packages and installs any that are missing. `here::i_am()` places
this notebook in the repository, so paths resolve from the repository root.

```{r setup}
pacman::p_load(here, dplyr, tidyr, purrr, stringr, ggplot2, readxl, writexl)
here::i_am("05_Mitochondria/03_complex_subunits/a_script/03_complex_subunits.qmd")
```

## Read inputs

Each subunit and assembly factor of complexes I to V, with its training change in each leg, side
by side. Adapted from Sam's PR #26 (sc-norton). It is descriptive only: the inference is fry on the
complexes in `02_test_mito`.

`de` is the stage 02 `DEP_matrix`, one row per protein with logFC, p and BH-adjusted p per
contrast. `membership` lists the MitoCarta sets; `complex_tests` holds fry's complex results.

```{r read}
stage <- here("05_Mitochondria", "03_complex_subunits")
de <- read_excel(
  here("02_Differential_Expression", "02_Differential", "c_data", "02_differential.xlsx"),
  "DEP_matrix"
)
membership <- read_excel(
  here("05_Mitochondria", "01_build_mito_sets", "c_data", "01_build_mito_sets.xlsx"),
  "membership"
)
complex_tests <- read_excel(
  here("05_Mitochondria", "02_test_mito", "c_data", "02_test_mito.xlsx"),
  "complex_tests"
)
```

## Collect the subunits

Keep the measured genes of the MitoPathways "CI subunits" to "CV assembly factors", split the set
name into complex and role, and join each gene to its stage 02 row by symbol. `.data[[...]]` picks
the DEP_matrix columns by built-up name. Rows sort within complex and role by the interaction
logFC, BFR minus HLRT.

```{r subunits}
complexes <- c("CI", "CII", "CIII", "CIV", "CV")
arms <- c(BFR = "BFR_Post-Pre", HLRT = "HLRT_Post-Pre")
subunits <- membership |>
  filter(measured, str_detect(set, "^C(I|II|III|IV|V) (subunits|assembly factors)$")) |>
  separate_wider_delim(set, " ", names = c("complex", "role"), too_many = "merge") |>
  inner_join(de, by = c(gene = "Genes")) |>
  transmute(
    complex = factor(complex, complexes), role, gene, protein,
    BFR_logFC = .data[[paste0(arms["BFR"], "_logFC")]],
    BFR_fdr = .data[[paste0(arms["BFR"], "_adj.P.Val")]],
    HLRT_logFC = .data[[paste0(arms["HLRT"], "_logFC")]],
    HLRT_fdr = .data[[paste0(arms["HLRT"], "_adj.P.Val")]],
    difference = `Modality_x_Time_Interaction_logFC`,
    difference_fdr = `Modality_x_Time_Interaction_adj.P.Val`
  ) |>
  arrange(complex, role, desc(difference))
head(subunits, 3)
```

## The set-level test

Sam's version tested BFR against HLRT with a paired t-test across the subunits of each complex.
That counts correlated proteins as independent replicates and makes p too small. The one valid
set-level test here is fry on the subunits, standard fit, interaction contrast, and it goes in the
panel titles. Assembly factors have no set test.

```{r interaction-fry}
interaction_fry <- complex_tests |>
  filter(fit == "standard", contrast == "Modality_x_Time_Interaction") |>
  transmute(complex = str_remove(set, " subunits"), fry_fdr = FDR)
interaction_fry
```

## Figures

Three A4 pages go to `b_reports/03_complex_subunits.pdf`, sharing one theme.

```{r theme}
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 9))
theme_update(
  plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 9, lineheight = 1.2),
  plot.caption.position = "plot", legend.position = "top", panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
)
```

Page 1 is Sam's summary layout: each complex's mean subunit change per leg with standard error,
and every subunit as a point. The jitter has its own seed, so the points land in the same place on
every run.

```{r summary-page}
summary_page <- subunits |>
  filter(role == "subunits") |>
  pivot_longer(c(BFR_logFC, HLRT_logFC), names_to = "arm", values_to = "logFC") |>
  mutate(arm = str_remove(arm, "_logFC")) |>
  ggplot(aes(complex, logFC, fill = arm)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey50") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "col", position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8, seed = 1),
    size = 0.9, alpha = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = interaction_fry, inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.8,
    aes(complex, Inf, label = paste("fry FDR", signif(fry_fdr, 2))), vjust = 1.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(BFR = "#B2182B", HLRT = "#2166AC"), name = NULL) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "log2 change, post - pre",
    caption = str_wrap(paste(
      "Complex subunits, summary by leg. Bars are the mean training change of each complex's",
      "measured subunits, with standard error; points are the subunits. The label is fry's",
      "interaction FDR on the complex, the set-level test of BFR against HLRT. Data: subunits",
      "sheet of 03_complex_subunits.xlsx."
    ), 115)
  )
```

Pages 2 and 3 draw every protein of one role by leg, one panel per complex. `role_page()` takes
the role and the caption's opening sentence. Panel titles carry the protein count and, where it
exists, fry's interaction FDR.

```{r role-page}
role_page <- function(which_role, title_text) {
  rows <- filter(subunits, role == which_role)
  headers <- rows |>
    count(complex) |>
    left_join(interaction_fry, by = "complex") |>
    mutate(panel = if_else(
      is.na(fry_fdr), sprintf("%s (%d)", complex, n),
      sprintf("%s (%d), fry interaction FDR %s", complex, n, signif(fry_fdr, 2))
    ))
  rows |>
    pivot_longer(c(BFR_logFC, HLRT_logFC), names_to = "arm", values_to = "logFC") |>
    mutate(
      arm = str_remove(arm, "_logFC"), gene = factor(gene, unique(rows$gene)),
      panel = headers$panel[match(complex, headers$complex)]
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(gene, logFC, fill = arm)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey50") +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~panel, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(BFR = "#B2182B", HLRT = "#2166AC"), name = NULL) +
    labs(
      x = NULL, y = "log2 change, post - pre",
      caption = str_wrap(paste(
        title_text, "Bars are each measured protein's training change in the BFR and the HLRT",
        "leg from the stage 02 fit, ordered within complex by BFR minus HLRT. Bars are not",
        "tested against each other: proteins of a complex are correlated, so the set-level test",
        "is fry in 02_test_mito, given in the panel title where it exists. Data: subunits sheet",
        "of 03_complex_subunits.xlsx."
      ), 115)
    ) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 6))
}
```

```{r pdf}
pdf(file.path(stage, "b_reports", "03_complex_subunits.pdf"), width = 8.27, height = 11.69)
walk(
  list(
    summary_page,
    role_page("subunits", "Complex subunits by leg."),
    role_page("assembly factors", "Complex assembly factors by leg.")
  ),
  print
)
invisible(dev.off())
```

## Summary

Proteins per complex and role, and how many reach BH FDR < 0.05 in each leg and for the
interaction.

```{r summary}
subunits |>
  summarise(
    proteins = n(), bfr_fdr_05 = sum(BFR_fdr < 0.05), hlrt_fdr_05 = sum(HLRT_fdr < 0.05),
    interaction_fdr_05 = sum(difference_fdr < 0.05), .by = c(role, complex)
  )
```

## Save results

`03_complex_subunits.xlsx` holds the overview and the `subunits` table.

```{r write}
overview <- data.frame(
  sheet = "subunits", rows = nrow(subunits),
  description = paste(
    "Measured subunits and assembly factors of complexes I to V: training logFC and BH FDR per",
    "leg, and the interaction (BFR minus HLRT) from the stage 02 fit."
  )
)
write_xlsx(
  list(overview = overview, subunits = subunits),
  file.path(stage, "c_data", "03_complex_subunits.xlsx")
)
```
